description: `extensions.opendan` of a Goal: trusted configuration written by the host's seeding path only (a UI, Goal or Work caller may not set it).

builtin.description: Stable identity of a built-in Goal (`memory_maintenance`).

capabilities.description: Host capabilities of its Goal Session (`memory_consolidation`).

records_perception.description: Whether its Goal Session may record perceptions (the consolidation Goal must not feed itself).
